jpmorgan.summary: The discussion focuses on the rebound in global equities, sector and regional leadership, and key risks to watch. JPMorgan highlights opportunities in U.S. tech and financials, as well as across Asia and emerging markets.

run_summary.overall_day_summary: Global equities have rebounded to all-time highs, driven by a shift in focus back to macroeconomic fundamentals and earnings. The market is watching sector and regional leadership, with a keen eye on key risks such as geopolitical tensions and inflationary pressures.
